title: Workmail attachment preview not loading
description: PDF attachments in Workmail not showing preview thumbnails. Started happening this morning. Wait, just realized browser extension was blocking scripts. Fixed by whitelisting domain.

title: Cannot access archived story transcripts from 2024
description: Trying to pull up interview transcripts from archived stories but the media library search isn't returning anything before Jan 2025. Checked the folder structure and found the old archive path was just renamed—nevermind, found it.

title: Cannot access archived story drafts from 2025
description: Trying to access archived story drafts from last year but the archive filter seems to not be working. Getting empty results when filtering by date range 2025-01 to 2025-12. Wait, just realized I was looking at the wrong workspace folder. Never mind.

title: Unable to access archive folder permissions
description: Getting permission denied when trying to open shared archive folder for 2025 investigations. Checked URL and realized I was using old bookmark - new structure moved to different path.

title: Cannot access archived interview transcripts folder
description: Trying to access the archived transcripts folder from Q3 2025 but getting a permissions error. Wait, never mind - I was looking at the old file server path. Found it in the new cloud storage location.
